feedback.end: The lower parts of both the oboe and the clarinet are called the bell.
The oboe has a double reed. This sticks out of the top.

atoms.b: Playing the oboe is not so easy as the reed must always be kept ((++moist dry)).
The player’s lips must also always be ((++tensed relaxed)) while playing.

atoms.a: The oboe has a very special, nasal sound. It can play middle and high notes.
The bassoon, on the other hand, is deep and rumbling. It can play the lowest notes of all the woodwind instruments.

trainers.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Like the oboe, the bassoon also has a double reed, but otherwise, these instruments are very different. The bassoon weighs over 3 kg, making it the heaviest woodwind instrument. It also has the lowest sound because it has the longest tube.

atoms.a: Which terms are appropriate for the bassoon?

atoms.text: The assembled bassoon is approximately 1.35 m long, but the path the air travels along is almost twice that! This is because it has to go around several bends: first through the curved S-bend, then down through the double tube and all the way back up and out the top.

b: ++The bassoon has an S-bend and a double tube.
The bassoon has an F-bend and a double tube.
The bassoon has a C-bend and a single tube.

feedback.finish: The double tube makes the bassoon shorter and therefore easier to play.

trainers.instruction: Trace the path of the air through the bassoon.
